notes.title: Demo v0.7.5 Live + New Trailer! Celebrating Six One Indie Breakout Selection
notes.content:
Hello, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture,

📢 New Demo + New Trailer

Demo v0.7.5 is live! And we're celebrating Gloomy Juncture being selected as a breakout game for Six One Indie!

They invited me to make an introduction... Big mistake. Anyway, check it out and don't blink, because you might miss important details... 🐈🔫 

Here's the presentation, featuring Link the Black Cat, and followed by the New Official Trailer:
[previewyoutube=waVpX6GQH_M;full][/previewyoutube]

The showcase was streamed live on Six One Indie, IGN, GameSpot & GameTrailers, here's the whole showcase (Gloomy Juncture starts at 44m44s) - still can't believe it 👀

But if you like it spicy, I've also released the uncensored version of the trailer on YouTube:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bfGYIvn9wKYhttps://youtu.be/bfGYIvn9wKY

General Demo Changes

[ FEATURES ]

 Scrollable Inventory: Mouse scroll will equip/unequip the last selected item (or most recent if none is selected)
 Toggle Puzzles will now auto equip the required item (if nothing is equipped) when the player wrongfully tries a 'Normal Interaction' (e.g., 'Peculiar Crystal Boxes')

[ IMPROVEMENTS ]

 A few interactable titles changed to better fit the narrative
 Added extra and alternative narration lines of different types, such as: item pickup feedback, focus on interactables, and dynamic events
 New Office Computer shader effect with new animation improvements
 The Cretin remains interactable while looking at TV (the behavior will change on full release with new animations and dialog lines)
 Puzzle Solved sfx/jingle no longer plays when interacting with Toggle Puzzles (e.g., 'Peculiar Crystal Boxes')

[ FIXES ]

 A bug that sometimes prevented the Item name to appear on the hint UI at the first interaction
 A very rare bug in Dragon Dungeon that incorrectly showed the key as not picked

 
If you want to reach out, join us on Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/Xh5qY7W7fX

I'd love to hear your thoughts and get all your feedback.

Cheers,
Filipe

notes.title: Gloomy Juncture | Early Uncensored Trailer
notes.content:
Hello dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture,


📢 Gloomy Juncture Early Trailer Debut - With Story, Original Score, and a Smoke Machine...

This past week, Gloomy Juncture was featured in two major events: the Six One Indie Steam Event and the OTK Games Expo. To mark the occasion, I finally released an Early Official Trailer, tighter, more awesome, and with an original score!

It dives deeper into the story, showcases fresh game content, and yes… features a (ridiculous?) live-action segment 👀

Let’s just say I found myself sneaking through my (public) garage late at night, wearing a trench coat and fedora, carrying cardboard boxes, a fake revolver, and a giant bamboo fence... all while leaving behind a suspicious smoke trail. It was glorious. Possibly illegal? No, trust me 😏. Suspicious? Absolutely. Worth it? Yes.  

A Note on Censorship

The trailer also premiered at the OTK Games Expo, although a censored version was shown. That was a bit disappointing, since nudity and profanity in Gloomy Juncture aren’t gratuitous, they serve a purpose in the narrative. Still, I fully respect OTK’s guidelines and really appreciated their generous back-and-forth. 

A Milestone in Creative Collaboration

This trailer also marks a major milestone: the first creative collaboration for Gloomy Juncture, featuring the incredible composer Rui Rodrigues.
His score really made all the difference, as he was able to enter in my weird mind and somehow capture exactly what I was looking for. An amazingly talented guy!

🎵 Check out his work: ruirodriguesmusic.com


Without further ado, here's the Early Uncensored Trailer:

[previewyoutube="1upvejNK584;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Gloomy Juncture Demo – Major Update (Shift to Run) & Discord Server Live!
notes.content:
Hello, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture,

I’m excited to announce that Demo v0.7.2 of Gloomy Juncture is now live! Thanks to the incredible feedback I've received from the Tiny Teams 2024 community (a huge shoutout to all the new players) and the insights from the Indie Cup Europe '24 jurors, I’ve been working hard to apply a new layer of polish, improvements, and quality-of-life updates to the game and demo.

This update brings the Gloomy Juncture demo closer to it's final experience, and It would mean a lot to me if you gave it a try. Whether you’re discovering it for the first time or returning for another playthrough, I’m confident you'll notice a more refined and immersive experience.

Gloomy Juncture v0.7.2
The update includes the following changes:

 Added new Splash Screen & Intro Credits.
 Revamped the game's introduction to clarify the setting, story and player objectives.
 Introduced new voice narrations as subtle hints, triggered by interactions and events.
 Added new voice narrations to provide deeper insight into the game world.
 New remarks from the cretin to enhance the world and player understanding of the setting.
 New voice narrations for the Wrong Usage of items. More intuitive voiceovers that enhance gameplay feedback.
 Refined the puzzle design and clarity with updated assets, improved interfaces and enhanced visual/audio cues. Providing clearer feedback on player actions and progress. Some specific puzzle enhancements include:
    • Power Panel: Updated interface with intuitive animations and a progress indicator.
    • Dragon Dungeon: Implemented a new AI system for a more strategic gameplay.
    • Fortune Teller: Enhanced the pipe-following by adding shadow projections on pipes, improving depth perception and reducing frustration.
 New RUN feature. Press Shift to move faster (key binding can be changed). 
 Head Bobbing during run can be toggled on/off in Settings.
 Updated journal entries and inventory item descriptions for a better fit within the game's atmosphere.
 Added new assets and models as subtle enhancements, designed to enrich the narrative atmosphere without directly affecting gameplay.
 Fixed an issue where journal entries were not scaling correctly with certain screen resolutions.
 Fixed an issue where the player character would occasionally move for a few frames before stopping when a cutscene was triggered.
 Improved 3D audio distance attenuation on certain objects. 
 Improved shadows to better align with maximum gamma and brightness settings, ensuring visual consistency across different screens and configurations.
 Improved interactions with certain game objects, reducing frustration caused by obstructions and awkward angles.
 Enhanced some Japanese translations for improved clarity and accuracy.

Discord Server
I've also (finally) created a Discord server. Please feel free to join if you want to hangout, provide feedback on this new update, or even help me with playtesting.
Note: I'll be providing beta keys as soon as new builds are ready to test. 

Discord Invite Link: https://discord.gg/Xh5qY7W7fX


Hope to see your feedback on Discord.

Thank you,
Filipe

notes.title: Gloomy Juncture Wins Visual Excellence Award at BitSummit 2024!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/d5473763767038ad3222ff481971e6c7a812b1f9.png
Hello, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture!

VISUAL EXCELLENCE AWARD WINNER

Gloomy Juncture won the Visual Excellence Award at BitSummit in Japan!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/6a4250292ea7ecefc683c4f0cd40cde21cef0749.png
BitSummit is Japan's industry-leading independent game development festival, held in Kyoto from July 19th to 21st, 2024. Gloomy Juncture was an official selection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/b94cbd1301aa7bbb581a2e5c81a3bb381c1b8bcf.png
The creative journey is filled with insecurities and can be a lonesome one, so this recognition means the world to me. Also I must confess that Gloomy Juncture winning the first award in Japan—the country responsible for my passion in video games and renowned for its industry that excels in high-quality, innovative titles—is more than I could ever dream to achieve in life. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/98c884d49daf4bdf0ccd534346697c76110741d3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/3310e0c2bdbd7ce973e0a27495442841b2a63874.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/df1a0f8f445af8ddf75172ae973beb6ba4fb8374.png
Professor and Game Designer Iida Kazutoshi from Ritsumeikan University shared these kind words about this peculiar work:

"A puzzle game in a chaotic world that calls in for your sanity. Solving puzzles is about restoring order. However, in this work, the paradoxical puzzle feeling of being drawn deeper into a person's world of madness the more puzzles you solve is very appealing. 

Furthermore, the fact that it is done by a single developer drawing for the first time and using those drawings directly into the game brings a new shake-up to the somewhat stagnating indie game world, making it the most controversial work in the history of BitSummit, depicting a fascinating decadence with a sort of outsider art feel."

AWARD PRESENTATION AND ACCEPTANCE SPEECH
[previewyoutube=IHjxV7VIgUo;full][/previewyoutube]
HAND-PICKED BY SWERY (HIDETAKA SUEHIRO) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/6fa84c424f8af52c2eed3e91d4a4b72ff0847d8c.jpg
On the second day of BitSummit, this weird game was honored to be one of five indies hand-picked by legendary game director SWERY (Hidetaka Suehiro) from the entire festival!

On stage, SWERY shared:

"It's an incredibly cool art style, isn't it? All the textures are done by a single person. The development company consists of one guy and one cat, making a new type of point & click in the first person. This is a mystery game set in a noir world with a unique style, where you experience the inside of someone’s mental state."

"Also, I tried to play during the interview, but there was a guy playing who was really concentrated. I tried to give him a hint, but it didn't work."

This recognition from the creator of Deadly Premonition is such a tremendous honor that, even a few days later, I'm still unable to process it...

SWERY SELECTION AND GLOOMY JUNCTURE INTERVIEW
[previewyoutube=91RRfmFVxXU;full][/previewyoutube]
FINAL THOUGHTS

People were lining up to play and, unfortunately, as happened with SWERY, not everyone had the opportunity to try the demo on site. Sorry about that, and I hope that at least you can enjoy the demo in the comfort of your home. I'm incredibly grateful for the recognition and warm welcome from the Japanese gaming community. Thank you, Japan! 

To the BitSummit team and everyone who voted for Gloomy Juncture - thank you from the bottom of my heart. Your support of indie developers is invaluable. 
I also want to express a special thanks to you guys, the community who supports me and shares opinions with so much love.

Finally, I'd like to sincerely thank Laura Teixeira. Not only did she do an awesome job representing me in Japan, but she also provided invaluable help with the Japanese translation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/3c66d399ac23491528092b951f21bde1c023db70.jpg

Thank you,
Filipe

notes.title: A Gloomy Juncture at Madrid's Mad Games Show | Post-Mortem Insights
notes.content:
Hello, Dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture.

Subtales Studio, my one-man studio, was selected by the Portuguese Association of Videogame Producers (APVP) to represent Portugal, with three other studios, at the Mad Games Show, in Madrid. This initiative was part of Gamiberica, a collaboration between the Portuguese Indie X event, APVP, and Indie Dev Play from Spain.

It was an honor for me to represent Portugal in Madrid, and I had the opportunity to showcase an updated build of Gloomy Juncture. This version features numerous quality-of-life improvements, refined gameplay mechanics, enhanced puzzles, and visual upgrades. While I'm excited about these changes, I'm even more thrilled about the new content in development—but that's a reveal for another day!

A Thank You to the Steam Community
I'd like to extend my heartfelt thanks to the Steam community. Your feedback on the public demo released in February has been invaluable, driving many of these improvements. In the coming weeks, I'll be sharing a detailed post outlining all these changes, so keep an eye out for that.

Looking ahead, I'm pleased to announce that Gloomy Juncture's new demo will soon be available to play at two physical locations on different continents. I'll be sharing more specifics about these venues in the next few days. And there's more—stay tuned for a special surprise I'll be unveiling next month!

Now, to Madrid.

Mad Games Show at Matadero, Madrid: A Rewarding Experience
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/f93fd2e5993e74ce778af912931ba0877d6ffa03.jpgMatadero is beautiful!

Matadero, a former slaughterhouse turned cultural center, is a breathtaking blend of industrial architecture and modern design. Its vast spaces and artistic ambiance provided the perfect set for the gaming showcase.

The Day Before: Setting Up the Booth
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/f6bbd18dd6a0f683d02bfda2c4052e731f4c81a6.jpgThe Portuguese delegation all setup

Upon arrival, I took a moment to explore the venue, marveling at its transformation and the buzz of excitement as other developers prepared their booths. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/49ae6cc03223962e84879c5b0acb076c500d68f0.jpgA nice poster prepared by the Indie Dev Play organization

The Event: Highlights and Interactions
I felt inspired and also challenged! I met a lot of folks with peculiar tastes that 'clicked' with this weird game at the booth. It was heartwarming to see people catching references and nuances during the prologue and even wanting to discuss the narrative and throwing guesses about the plot 💙

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/646a35de5cefffffc34d62c8fb7c647c4c68f24b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/421249f17946b745d1dbaaa2f8b23ac5943dfd97.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/aade5b714728e953ffa0af1faf94318933879123.jpgLots of weirdos enjoying Gloomy Juncture!

Madrileños are Incredible
Dozens of people tried Gloomy Juncture, and it received an enthusiastic reception. The cultural engagement by visitors blew my mind! Everyone was eager to discuss my influences, movies, creative process, concept, and art style. 

People were curious about the challenges faced by a solo developer and how I conceived this peculiar art style, and wanted to know more about the concept of a first-person point & click game. Madrid features a very warm and friendly audience that was a huge pleasure to interact with.

A Cozy Space in Matadero
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/345ab7d0de58ea9cb1a707887b822577e6f98239.jpgThe showcase extended across two floors

The event also had cool networking spots where I met some passionate potential partners. Congratulations to the peeps at Indie Dev Day for a great event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/ddad129900c8eccde026bbfc17362e7299378df3.jpgPost-Event Harvest: Awesome Contacts

For the new spanish wishlists, and all who stopped by, played the prologue, praised my work and chatted for a bit: ¡Muchas gracias por la calidez humana! 🙏

What's Next?
If you're excited about Gloomy Juncture, please add it to your Steam wishlist! Your support means the world to me and helps tremendously. Consider following the game for future updates as well. 

Thank you for being part of this journey and for your invaluable role in shaping Gloomy Juncture into the best experience possible. Your involvement is truly making a difference!

Filipe

If you appreciate my work, there has never been a better opportunity to open the purse than to bid for such a noble cause, and you'll have the chance to own this awesome poster printed on canvas (70x100cm).

Expos and Recent Events
Gloomy Juncture has been selected as a finalist to showcase in several prestigious events, including the MIX & Kinda Funny Showcase 2024  in San Francisco during GDC, Reboot Develop Blue 2024 in Dubrovnik, and most recently in Mobidictum Network Lisbon 2024.

Although time and budget constraints prevent the attendance at the San Francisco and Dubrovnik events, this allowed me to focus on improving the game itself, ensuring that your feedback is integrated into the development process.

At Mobidictum Network Lisbon 2024, I took the opportunity to showcase Gloomy Juncture and conduct some playtesting focused on addressing Quality of Life (QoL) improvements based on your feedback. These enhancements primarily targeted UI/UX, general puzzle tuning, interaction with the Inventory, game objects and hitbox detection. The feedback received was incredibly positive, fueling my excitement to share a new build with you guys soon!

Thank you for your continued support and involvement in shaping Gloomy Juncture into the best experience possible.

Filipe

notes.title: Gloomy Juncture at Gamiberica in MEO XL GAMES: November 23rd to 26th
notes.content:
Hello, Dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture.

MEO XL & Gamiberica
MEO XL is the biggest gaming event in Portugal. It took place at Exponor (Porto, Portugal) between November 23rd and 26th. For the first time, it hosted Gamiberica, the Iberian Games Summit—the first conference dedicated to debating the video game industry in the Iberian Peninsula. It took place on the 24th of November, organized by Indie X, IndieDevDay, and with the support of APVP - Associação de Produtores de Videojogos Portugueses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/3007c2c1c0cd03b8ea95bf24422ff08953ab3fdb.jpg
Gamiberica strives to foster meaningful connections within the Spanish and Portuguese indie industry, facilitating collaboration among studios, investments, and talent. The establishment of a dedicated space for such interactions proves highly advantageous for all involved, thanks to the partnership between IndieX and IndieDevDay.

Gloomy Juncture at MEO XL
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/c876b009a6811b268ad3170a00694a4e6fc0e8f6.jpg
Gamiberica featured a showcase of 30 games from Portuguese and Spanish studios. Being my first public showcase, I was present for the entire four days. Despite initial nervousness about being a game in such a niche genre, it was heartening to witness players across all age ranges engaging with enthusiasm and persevering through every puzzle until the end of the Prologue. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/243d91a6d2c2688c89deb1b96f48cbfed495ef86.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/b25cbeaa5d594a356df87f965da9decb052ca313.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/389cbd502b54d21c7add6bffd2203f5ee48c067c.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/fe45e5537b8e8e82db3fd4acae7fed8ca34d1ee4.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/d65cce831f52ff6818791cff5edc36ee8d1c0784.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/2927f6941a36abe28c502de636c405b9633525f6.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/a09d784d495e110e2c8a8d5c33b45b35c0d56b33.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/71b39f1ff8828a5594ed3c667867b2c76041299f.jpg

I've been humbled by the amazing feedback. To everyone who visited the booth, asked about development, played Gloomy Juncture, shared an opinion, or said it was a must-buy—thank you! Your support has made it all worth it already! 💗

Stay tuned, as more exciting news is on the way!

Thanks,
Filipe

notes.title: Exploring the Artistic Journey of Gloomy Juncture | Dev Update
notes.content:
Greetings, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture.

For the past 2.5 years, I have poured my heart and soul into this project.
So why is it taking so long? Gloomy Juncture is a first person 3D game where every single asset is meticulously and exclusively hand-drawn by me. Discover more about this process in the video below.

[previewyoutube=0JqQ3BCk_k0;full][/previewyoutube]
DEV STATUS

I'm actively working to expand the game's content, ensuring that it lives up to the high standards I've set for it. However, there are still two entire levels that need my attention. Crafting each element by hand is a time-consuming process, but it's the only way to achieve the artistic vision I have in mind.

UPDATE ON RELEASE DATE

I hope to release Gloomy Juncture in early 2024, but I refrain from compromising on an exact date at this time. I won't compromise on quality or rush the process. 

Rest assured, when Gloomy Juncture is ready and I am genuinely happy with the final product, it will be launched for all to enjoy. 

I'm immensely grateful for your patience and support throughout this journey. Please stay tuned for further updates as we draw closer to the release date.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/71119bd0ea4f42ae9d80efc9e4d064f973f4f064.png
Thank you,
Filipe
